vision.statement: Turn Visual Studio Code Insiders into the governed local workbench for mapping, coordinating, and validating agents across Cabina Universal surfaces.
vision.problemStatement: The machine already has many agent-capable extensions, CLIs, repos, skills, validators, and dashboards, but without a local canvas they remain scattered surfaces instead of an operator-visible control table.
vision.proposedSolution: Use Agile Agent Canvas as a local, versioned planning surface that connects extension inventory, agent governance, dashboard evidence, validators, gates, and next safe execution lanes without invoking secrets or live writes.

targetUsers.description: Needs a single local cockpit to decide which agents, tools, repos, and gates are ready.
Needs repo-scoped artifacts, validators, rollback paths, and explicit stop conditions before changing systems.
Needs durable readbacks, matrices, and local evidence that can be reviewed later.
Needs clear boundaries for live, tenant, cost, production, secrets, and regulated data.

successMetrics.description: The root Agile Agent Canvas artifacts identify Cabina Universal, not demo project data.
Every active VSI agent surface has owner, gate, validator, rollback, and stop condition.
The dashboard, matrices, canvas artifacts, and validators can be inspected without live provider calls.
Secret, Jira, OpenAI live, Microsoft live, Graph, Power Platform, production, and remote mutation lanes remain gated until exact target and rollback exist.
